definitions.ask: Should a third @ still start the template when bob has already absorbed the line's @route into @@route?
definitions.why: Otherwise the gesture fails on lines with a plain @route unless typed faster than bob answers

choices.label: Ask bob to start it from the pre-absorption line; `Buy milk @dev @@@` works at any typing speed
The third @ types literally (`Buy milk @@dev@`); docs say to type @@@ before the route

definitions.ask: Should the gesture also erase the spaces or tabs typed just before @@@?
definitions.why: The line reads as it did before the gesture, like @@ absorption's whitespace tidy

choices.label: `Read {0} @@@` leaves `Read {0}` with the caret at its end
Only the three @ go; `Read {0} ` keeps its trailing space and the caret after it
